description: One event in full: every date and term, the filing and the sentence or table row it came from, tokenized versions in the Asset Map, and the event as an ISO 20022 seev.031.001.14 notification (checked by the Test Bench). With as_of, the event as the feed showed it at the end of that day; with history, every version: when the feed first showed it, what changed and when, and the filing and code behind each.

as_of.description: A day, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2026-10-29 on: the event as the feed showed it then.

history.description: true for every version of the event and what changed, instead of the event itself.

id.description: The event id, from list_corporate_actions or holdings_calendar.

name: get_corporate_action
title: One corporate action, with its seev.031 message
